messages:
alice.r: quick note from halley-30b int3 QA. observed a reproducible token shift after a prefill boundary when scaling ctx from 32k -> 64k. easy repro attached.
tom.k: can you give the short repro steps? is this only on multi-shard runs?
alice.r: steps: 1) prefill 31,900 tokens, 2) inject a 6-token system message, 3) continue generation 800 tokens. seed fixed. on 2-shard a100 setup it flips at ~+1 token in layer 4 kv pointers. single-shard fp16 is clean.
nora: sounds like a packing rollover. int3 packing uses 5-bit groups with 64-byte tiles in our fused loader. if prefill crosses a tile boundary and we recompute offsets with floor division we could get a +1.
alice.r: here's the dump snippet and the helper command i used:
```
# run repro
python -m tests.longctx_repro --model halley-30b-int3 --seed 7 --prefill 31900 --inject-system "<SYS>" --gen 800 --dump-kv-anchors /tmp/kv.json
# quick parse
grep -E "layer[0-9]+\.anchor|kv_ptr" /tmp/kv.json | head -n 40
```
build-bot: build/2026.03.04-int3-shardfix queued on staging.
tom.k: try setting PREFETCH_TILE=128 and KV_ALIGN_CHECK=1; if the bug disappears it's alignment. also check rotor scaling: set ROTARY_INTERP=linear vs default.
alice.r: i tried PREFETCH_TILE=128 and bug persisted, but KV_ALIGN_CHECK=1 flagged two offsets where pointer mod 64 != 0. changed PREFETCH_TILE to 64 to match mod and the flip went away.
sam: interesting. could also be a difference in our shard-join codepath where we recompute base_offset += floor(tokens/pack_per_tile). i can review math.
nora: please collect a minimal failing trace (just layer offsets + k/v digest) and attach to model-onboard ticket. I'll add a small unit test that simulates tile rollover for int3 packing.
alice.r: uploading trace and opening ticket INF-4392. attaching short golden diffs vs int4 and fp16. divergence: 0.5% tokens after 800 gen.
tom.k: if we can get a tiny fix that forces TILE_SIZE alignment for quant builds, we should do it as a safe fallback in runtime. also run the matrix across shard counts 1/2/4 to ensure no hidden race.
build-bot: test/matrix(1,2,4)-halley-30b-int3 started.
sam: i'll prototype the math fix and post a patch slack link here in the next few hours. thanks all.
